description:
# WorldManager for PowerNukkitX

WorldManager is a powerful multiworld management plugin for PowerNukkitX. It provides commands and form-based user interfaces for creating, managing, configuring, and navigating worlds.

## Features

- Teleport to another world
- World teleport UI
- World generation UI
- Generate worlds with a custom generator and seed
- Delete worlds
- List loaded and unloaded worlds
- Load, unload, and reload worlds
- Rename worlds
- Copy, duplicate, and back up worlds
- Set the world spawn
- Regenerate worlds
- Change the seed of an existing world
- Display world information such as seed, generator, and player count
- Optional per-world game modes
- UI-based settings
- Change the default world
- Load worlds on server startup
- Restrict access to worlds using permissions
- Remove all entities from a world
- Change the biome of loaded chunks
- Manage game rules through a UI
- Enable or disable the built-in movement check per world
- Add notes to worlds
- Protect worlds against building, breaking, and interactions
- Synchronize game rules and settings between worlds
- Set a player limit per world
- Locate nearby biomes

## Commands and permissions

The main command is `/worldmanager`. The aliases `/wm`, `/mw`, `/levelmanager`, `/lm`, and `/mv` are also available.

Users with the `worldmanager.admin` permission can use all WorldManager features. Command permissions generally follow this pattern:

```text
worldmanager.<main-subcommand>
```

For example, `/wm generate` requires `worldmanager.generate`. The complete command and alias list is available in-game and in the console with `/wm help`.

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `/worldmanager teleport <world> [player]` | Teleports you or another player to a world. Aliases: `tp`, `to`. |
| `/worldmanager generate <world> [generator] [seed]` | Generates a world. Aliases: `gen`, `create`. |
| `/worldmanager delete <world>` | Deletes a world. Aliases: `del`, `remove`, `purge`. |
| `/worldmanager list` | Lists all worlds. |
| `/worldmanager load <world>` | Loads a world. |
| `/worldmanager unload <world>` | Unloads a world. |
| `/worldmanager reload [world]` | Reloads a world. |
| `/worldmanager rename <world> <new-name>` | Renames a world. |
| `/worldmanager copy [world] [copy-name]` | Copies a world. |
| `/worldmanager setspawn` | Sets the spawn of the current world. |
| `/worldmanager settings [world]` | Opens the world-specific settings UI. |
| `/worldmanager regenerate [world]` | Regenerates a world. Aliases: `reg`, `reset`. |
| `/worldmanager setseed <world> <seed>` | Changes a world's seed. Alias: `reseed`. |
| `/worldmanager info [world]` | Displays information about a world. |
| `/worldmanager setbiome <biome>` | Changes the biome of every loaded chunk in the current world. |
| `/worldmanager gamerule [world]` | Opens the game-rule UI. |
| `/worldmanager version` | Displays the installed WorldManager version. |
| `/worldmanager killentitys <world>` | Removes all entities from a world. |
| `/worldmanager sync [template-world]` | Synchronizes game rules and settings with a template world. |
| `/worldmanager locatebiome <biome> [range] [teleport]` | Searches nearby chunks for a biome. |
| `/worldmanager spawn` | Teleports you to the spawn of the current world. |
| `/worldmanager default [world]` | Displays or changes the default world. |

### Additional permissions

| Permission | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `worldmanager.deny.<world>` | Prevents a player from entering the specified world. |
| `worldmanager.teleport.<world>` | Allows `/worldmanager teleport` only for the specified world. |
| `worldmanager.teleportui` | Allows access to the world teleport UI. |
| `worldmanager.generationui` | Allows access to the world generation UI. |
